items.en: In an argument, I always remain objective and stick to the facts.
items.zh: 争论时，我总能保持客观、就事论事。

items.en: Even if I am feeling stressed, I am always friendly and polite to others.
items.zh: 即使感到压力，我也总是友好、有礼貌地对待别人。

items.en: When talking to someone, I always listen carefully to what the other person says.
items.zh: 与人交谈时，我总是认真听对方说话。

items.en: It has happened that I have taken advantage of someone in the past.
items.zh: 过去我曾占过别人的便宜。

items.en: I have occasionally thrown litter away in the countryside or on to the road.
items.zh: 我偶尔曾在郊外或路上乱扔垃圾。

items.en: Sometimes I only help people if I expect to get something in return.
items.zh: 有时，只有觉得会得到回报，我才帮助别人。

instructions.en: The following statements may apply more or less to you personally. Please indicate to what extent they apply to you.
instructions.zh: 下面这些说法与你的实际情况可能有不同程度的符合。请指出每句话与你有多符合。
